scope.change: Add an ownership-checked cleanup executor over app-owned user data and a package adapter seam.
scope.preservation: Only marked app-owned root and per-vault cache/recovery/failed directories are eligible. Vault files, unresolved conflicts, journals, ownership markers, unknown paths, and unowned neighboring directories remain. Recovery directories are retained when journals are pending, failed, malformed, unreadable, oversized, or exceed the pending-operation bound.
scope.adapter: Expose explicit CLI selection flags and CredentialStore::delete_all_for_application for a future native package adapter. There is no OS credential backend or package-manager invocation yet; credential deletion reports unavailable instead of claiming success.
scope.fixture: The shared uninstall-preservation fixture includes ownership markers, a prepared rename journal, its before-image, conflicts, cache/history, unknown neighbors, and an unowned hash directory.

accepted_validation.conclusion: All six required GitHub Actions workflows passed on the exact source SHA.
passed_checks: workspace tests, including cleanup and preservation fixtures
accepted_validation.local_executable_validation: None; executable validation ran only in GitHub Actions.

remaining: The R6 native package/uninstaller must call the cleanup adapter only after the desktop process exits; actual OS uninstall preservation remains unvalidated until a package format is selected.
Credential cleanup remains unavailable until an OS credential backend implements application-scoped deletion.
The current UI cleanup choices are a preview and do not invoke the adapter.
